question: Up to what height may the bhadra be constructed upon the sub-base?
premises: The sub-base provides a height reference.
The bhadra may extend up to that height.
This construction is prescribed as an option.
inference: The bhadra may be made extending up to the height of the sub-base.
uncertainties: The fused form kartavyamupa may conceal a sandhi boundary.
plain_english: Or the bhadra should be made extending up to the height of the sub-base.
